description: The line plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers, comparing values before and after gating, as well as against a baseline. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24, and the y-axis is labeled 'Abs Mean' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5. The blue dashed line represents the 'hidden state mean before gate,' which shows a steady increase across layers, peaking at approximately 5.5 in layer 24. The orange dotted line represents the 'hidden state mean after gate,' which remains relatively stable across layers, with a slight decline after layer 15. The green solid line represents the 'hidden state mean of baseline,' which remains consistently below the post-gating values across all layers. The legend in the top left provides a clear description of the three lines.
